route: /style-board/ (the style board: module cta:inline, longest and shortest copy, photos as grey frames)

findings.issue: On phones the quote button still runs the full column width (about 350 px, larger label type than the body) and reads as a heavy black bar under the copy; this asks again for the earlier P2's change and so undoes the phone full-width rule in reference.css for this module, because the mobile shot shows the competitor's inline CTA uses small buttons, not full-width pills.
findings.reference: The competitor's inline CTA (product_manufacturer 13) keeps its two black buttons small and sized to their one-line labels on phones, sitting side by side under the text with an 8px radius and 12px 24px padding.
findings.fix: In src/styles/reference.css, keep the max-width: 767px full-width rule for the other CTA variants but override it for the inline one: .block--cta[data-variant="inline"] .cta .button { width: auto; max-width: 100%; padding: 12px 24px; } so the button is sized to its label and starts on the left edge under the paragraph.
